title: Introduce credential concierge, compact stream facade, and cross-SDK parity fixes (py/ts/go)
author: Maya Thompson
release_notes: Adds a lightweight 'credential concierge' abstraction that centralizes credential lookup/fallback and telemetry across SDKs; introduces a compact, ergonomic stream facade (pull-stream friendly) with improved resume semantics; fixes cross-language parity issues around stream cursor iteration and token-refresh races; bumps Python/TS/Go SDK minor versions.
description: Context and motivation: customer teams reported a set of interrelated SDK ergonomics problems when long-running streams encounter credential rotations and transient infra errors: (1) duplicate reauth attempts from parallel consumers, (2) inconsistent cursor/resume behavior between Python/TS/Go, and (3) differing retry presets that made service-level parity testing brittle. This PR introduces a small cross-SDK surface called the 'credential concierge' (a thin, opinionated orchestrator for credential lookups + telemetry) plus a compact stream facade that normalizes resume semantics and reduces boilerplate for application code. Work completed: - Implement credential concierge in each SDK (Python/TS/Go) with a consistent public API and pluggable provider chain. - Add adaptive retry profiles (idle-window, short-burst, long-tail) and ensure the same defaults across SDKs. - Replace low-level stream consumer helpers with a compact pull-stream facade that exposes a stable async iterator/async generator contract and a lightweight resume token. - Fix edge-case race where token refresh and stream reconnect could cause duplicate request bodies to be replayed. - Add end-to-end parity tests (matrix py/ts/go) and update docs + changelogs. Checklist: [x] API design doc reviewed (ENG-4521) [x] All unit + e2e tests added [x] Docs updated and sample snippets included [x] Version bumps applied to packaging and changelogs Notes: description intentionally concise; implementation keeps runtime allocations minimal and avoids cross-process state.
commits: feat(concierge): add credential concierge interface and default provider chain
feat(stream): compact pull-stream facade with resume token and backpressure hints
fix(auth): dedupe parallel refresh attempts and add idempotent reauth guard
chore(sdk): sync retry presets across py/ts/go and add adaptive profiles
test: add cross-language parity matrix and flaky fix for stream reconnect
docs: document concierge API and migration guide

Carlos Mendez: Tests look good. One behavior question: when the concierge falls back to the local provider, do we still emit the same telemetry? We should mark source=local in the event.

Priya Desai: CI flake on e2e matrix previously; re-run passes now. Approving pending squash commit message clean-up.
Evan Li: Approve. Recommend mention in release notes about migration steps for advanced custom credential providers.
notes_to_release_manager: This is a cross-SDK change that requires coordinated releases. Release plan: publish Python 1.8.0, TypeScript 2.3.1, Go 1.5.0 in the same release window. Migration guidance in docs/sdk/concierge.md: consumer code using low-level stream helpers should switch to the compact facade; advanced credential providers must implement the ConciergeProvider interface to get telemetry tags. No breaking changes for default usage, but custom providers using private internals may need small adaptions.
